title: Rabbi Shimon bar Nachman
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: So Otzar Yisrael cites, in its list of Amoraim’s names, from Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:16. Hyman says an uncorrected Midrash text came its way, since his Midrash texts read Rabbi Shmuel ben Nachman, the well-known sage.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:16 names Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman, beside Hyman's ben Nachman. The claim that Otzar Yisrael encountered an uncorrected text remains Hyman's explanation: neither Otzar Yisrael nor a census of Midrash editions was collated here. The Shimon heading is retained.
